instruction: Search for baby names that are variations of James

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking to search for name variations of James on babycenter.com. The evaluator checks if the user successfully navigated to the James name details page using URL pattern matching.
metadata.verification_notes: Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify URL pattern, avoiding the need for exact ID verification.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: URL pattern 'james-' is semantically incorrect for verifying 'variations of James'. The pattern only matches URLs containing literally 'james-' but the instruction asks for VARIATIONS like Jamie, Jim, Jameson, Jimmy, etc.

CRITICAL: The regex pattern is incomplete - it expects URLs to end with 'james-' but actual babycenter.com URLs are like 'james-1014' (with numeric ID suffix). The pattern won't match even if user searches for James itself.
Incomplete coverage: The evaluator cannot verify that the user actually searched for variations - it only checks if URL contains 'james-', missing all other valid variations.
Semantic mismatch: Instruction requires finding variations (Jamie, Jim, etc.) but pattern only accepts exact 'james-' match, which contradicts the task requirement.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix the URL pattern to match actual babycenter.com URL structure with numeric IDs: 'https://www\.babycenter\.com/baby-names/details/[a-z]+-\d+'
Update pattern to accept valid James variations: 'https://www\.babycenter\.com/baby-names/details/(james|jamie|jim|jimmy|jameson|jacoby|jamison)-\d+'
Consider simplifying to verify user reached any baby name details page from babycenter.com if exact variation list is hard to define: 'https://www\.babycenter\.com/baby-names/details/[a-z]+-\d+'
Add verification notes explaining which variations are considered valid for this task.
